corrections.reason: The enclitic conjunction on የመሆኗም is 6th-order ም (not 7th-order ሞ); the right loop is clearly closed at the top.
The printed word is ይዟት ('taking her', translating ነሥአ... ወአእተዋ ቤቶ), where ዟ was missegmented as ገባዋ.

corrections.old_text: እንዳይነ በጎ ያለ ባዘቶ ሠሀ የ
corrections.corrected_text: እንዳይነ በጎ ያለ ባዘቶ ውሀ የ
corrections.reason: The word is ውሀ ('water', i.e., sponge/wool that absorbs water ውሀ የሚያነሣ), where ው was misread as ሠ.
The feminine adjective translating ዓባይ ዕለታ is ክብርት ('honorable/great'), with 6th-order ክ and ብ claramente visible.
Across the line wrap, the word is ፊቱን ('his face', ፊቱን ወደርሱ መልሶ ተሰቅሎ ነበርና), with the 3rd-order vowel mark on ፊ.
